title: Finding
description: The language-neutral verdict currency emitted by every Check. Single source of truth; the Python and TypeScript implementations both conform to this shape and to the golden-vector corpora.

groundedness.description: SURFACE-INVARIANT: labeled once, every tier derived by policy.

$comment: IMMOVABLE POLICY INVARIANT (not expressible in JSON Schema, enforced in code): a finding with kind=deterministic AND groundedness=false ALWAYS resolves to action=drop; no policy table may override it.
